svg.text: For design understanding and early scope coordination only.
Detailed fixing, connection, and installation information is excluded.

foreignObject.div: Geometric patterns are produced as GRC/GFRC panels, modularized to project dimensions. Star, lattice, arabesque, and custom motifs are manufactured from project drawings and pattern files.
Mashrabiya screens provide controlled solar shading and visual privacy while allowing natural light diffusion and air circulation — functional performance integrated into the architectural facade.
Screen modules repeat across the facade with consistent bay spacing, creating a unified architectural rhythm. Panel sizing, depth, and void-to-solid ratio are coordinated to project elevations.
GRC/GFRC Mashrabiya elements bring regional and cultural identity to contemporary facades — heritage motifs and arch forms are faithfully reproduced from design references and historical sources.

svg.text: Screen Pattern Design — geometric motif and module
Solar Shading Effect — light and shadow control
Facade Rhythm — bay repetition and proportion
Cultural / Regional Expression — arch and motif identity
Integration with Openings — frame and panel coordination
DURRAKA FACTORY FOR INDUSTRY — GRC/GFRC MANUFACTURING
